products.name: Silk Repair Shampoo
products.description: A nourishing shampoo that gently cleanses while restoring softness and shine to damaged hair.
products.usage: Apply a small amount to wet hair. Massage into scalp, then rinse thoroughly. Follow with conditioner.

products.name: Radiance Hair Serum
products.description: Lightweight serum that tames frizz and adds mirror-like shine to every strand.
products.usage: Warm 2–3 drops between palms and smooth through damp or dry hair, avoiding the roots.

products.name: Velvet Matte Lipstick
products.description: A creamy matte lipstick with 12-hour wear and rich, buildable color.
products.usage: Apply directly to lips. Blot with tissue for a softer finish.

products.name: Hydra Glow Cream
products.description: 72-hour hydration cream infused with hyaluronic acid for a plump, dewy complexion.
products.usage: Apply morning and evening to clean skin, gently pressing into face and neck.

products.name: Noir Eau de Parfum
products.description: A sophisticated blend of bergamot, jasmine, and warm woods.
products.usage: Spray onto pulse points: wrists, neck, and behind the ears.

products.name: Deep Repair Mask
products.description: Intensive weekly treatment for dry, chemically-treated hair.
products.usage: Apply to damp hair, leave for 10 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.

products.name: Precision Eyeliner
products.description: Waterproof liquid liner with a fine-tip brush for effortless precision.
products.usage: Draw along lash line from inner to outer corner. Allow to dry fully.

products.name: Vitamin C Serum
products.description: Brightening serum that evens skin tone and boosts natural radiance.
products.usage: Apply 3–4 drops to clean skin every morning before moisturizer.

products.name: Rose Musk Perfume
products.description: Delicate rose petals meet soft musk in this feminine signature scent.

products.name: Ceramic Round Brush
products.description: Professional-grade ceramic brush for smooth, salon-quality blowouts.
products.usage: Use on damp hair while blow-drying, rolling from mid-lengths to ends.

products.name: Argan Oil Elixir
products.description: Pure argan oil that deeply nourishes and softens all hair types.
products.usage: Apply 2–3 drops to ends of dry or damp hair.

products.name: Bronzing Powder
products.description: Silky bronzer for a sun-kissed, natural-looking glow.
products.usage: Sweep across cheekbones, forehead, and jawline with a large brush.
